content: Please examine our database records for Chinese cities (country_code_2 = 'cn') during July 2021 and identify both the shortest and longest streaks of consecutive date entries. For each date in these streaks, return exactly one record per date along with the corresponding city name. In your output, please ensure the first letter of each city name is capitalized and the rest are lowercase. Display the dates and city names for both the shortest and longest consecutive date streaks, ordered by date.
